title: Existence of the normalized integral tensor presentation
statement: Fix l, E, Y, D and hl as in lem-sf-integral-hom-models-exist. There is a TensorPresentation for the completed integral coefficient sheaf.

proof.text: Obtain the closed derived tensor structure S and normalized comparison T. Package S.tensor, T.comparison, adj and this field as TensorPresentation. No arbitrary adjunction choice is made beforehand.
